contracts: (Result is terminal when the reduced set is rejected and the independent witness validates unchanged inputs.) AND (The guard result explicitly rejects the Phase target and leaves other inputs unchanged.) AND (The seed result contains stale classification tied to content mismatch.) AND (The structured evaluation result records rejected collision status.)
selector_intents: Invoke the Phase-fixture write guard against a Phase-owned path; fail if the guard permits the write or changes unrelated inputs.
Run the isolated collision fixture with the self-collision preserved; fail if rejection is not reported.
Run the isolated seed-mutation fixture; fail when changed seed content is accepted as current.
Run the policy-removal fixture against an evaluator that accepts the reduced VDD/Acceptance set; the rejection assertion must fail.
Run the policy-removal fixture without emitting its independent witness; verification must fail for absent proof.
